Appointment.description: The latest booking that was created, moved or cancelled.
Appointment.title: Appointment

schema.description: What one call knows. Every value has a default, as ``CallState`` requires.

appointment.description: The latest successful booking action, saved after the tool succeeds.

booking_date.description: Today's date in the salon's timezone, read once before the greeting.
booking_date.title: Booking Date

booking_weekday.description: The weekday of booking_date, in English.
booking_weekday.title: Booking Weekday

salon_local_time.description: The salon's wall clock when the call began.
salon_local_time.title: Salon Local Time

customer_phone.description: The caller's phone number in E.164. It shows in no prompt but verify_customer's until the caller agrees to it.
customer_phone.title: Customer Phone

requested_service.description: The service the caller asked for. Leave it out if they did not say.
requested_service.title: Requested Service

requested_day.description: The day the caller asked for, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out if they did not name one; never guess today.
requested_day.title: Requested Day

requested_intent.description: Whether the caller wants to book a new time, move theirs, or cancel it.
requested_intent.title: Requested Intent

customer_verified.description: What verification found on this call: existing or created. Empty means nobody was verified yet. Customer care reads it instead of the phone number.
customer_verified.title: Customer Verified

schema.title: State
